_comment: Mission environments. One-way communication delay in seconds. Null = no verified source (the app then shows the conservative escalation message). Mars transit uses the 3-22 minute range for Mars; the delay during transit grows from near zero, so this is the range at Mars. Lunar base uses the ESA average (min = max).

environments.name: Mars transit vehicle
environments.description: A crewed spacecraft travelling to Mars, far from Earth.

environments.name: Lunar surface base
environments.description: A crewed base on the surface of the Moon.
